title: Video in type
description: One or two very large words fill the width of the frame and their letters are windows: a clip runs inside the letter shapes. The letters come out of a blur one after another (GSAP stagger from the centre) and one line of text settles under them. For result clips and graphics: do not use a clip that shows a person's face, the letters would cut it up. A bright clip reads best.

props.src: required, a bright clip (mp4/webm) or picture without a person's face
props.word: required, one short word (3-9 letters), or a list of two short words, one per line: ["SLIDES", "AND WEB"]
props.kicker: small caps above, on the left
props.tag: small caps above, on the right
props.note: small caps under the word, on the right
props.poster: still shown before the video loads

example.alt: Stand-in clip: layered waves under a sun
